parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel of the table made of wood, providing structural support on one side.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and helps maintain the table’s stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel located near the drawer section, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides vertical support and forms part of the drawer compartment structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A central vertical side panel forming part of the drawer housing.
parts.Functional_description: It separates and supports the drawers, maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the opposite side of the drawer section, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and stability to the table structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A bottom panel located beneath the drawers, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the drawers and connects the vertical panels for structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A lower drawer made of wood, part of the table’s storage system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage space and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A middle drawer made of wood, part of the table’s storage system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage space for medium-sized items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: An upper drawer made of wood, part of the table’s storage system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage space for small items and is easily accessible.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the far end of the table, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides end support and stability to the tabletop.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The tabletop surface of the table made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main working or placing surface of the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
